    2: """
    3: S84-W7b-77-TWISTED-TRIPLE-ADMISSIBILITY
    4: 
    5: Tests whether the Connes-Moscovici (2008) twisted spectral triple generalization
    6: extends the singleton admissibility result {d_total=12, KO-dim=6, A_F=C(+)H(+)M_3(C)}
    7: from S83-G32 to any additional (d_internal, KO-dim, A_F, sigma) combination.

   10:   Enumerate 16 candidate twisted triples T-1..T-16.

   12:     F1: Mellin cone pairing (d_total=12 required)
   13:     F2: Connes-Marcolli 2013 Table 1 KO-dim sign table
   14:     F3: SM content match (3 generations + gauge bosons from A_F modules)
   15:     F4: Jensen deformation compatibility (sigma preserves monotonicity)
   16:   Count candidates passing ALL filters.
   17: 
   18: PASS iff count = 0 exactly (twisting does NOT extend singleton).
   19: 
   20: References:
   21:   - Connes-Moscovici 2008, "Type III and spectral triples" (arXiv:math/0609703)
   22:     Def 2.3: twisted spectral triple axioms (replaces [D,a] bounded by [D,a]_sigma)
   23:   - Connes-Marcolli 2013, "A walk in the noncommutative garden" Table 1
   24:     KO-dim sign table for (eps, eps', eps'')
   25:   - S83-G32 (singleton admissibility)
   26:   - S83-G36 (matrix-model classification)
   27:   - S82 Mellin cone admissibility filter
   28: """

    4: Pre-registered gate: S84-AF-SINGLETON-SM-COUPLINGS
    5:   Hypothesis: Starting from only A_F = C + H + M_3(C) + Chamseddine-Connes a_4 boundary condition
    6:               + 1-loop SM RGE, derive g_1(M_Z), g_2(M_Z), g_3(M_Z).
    7:   PASS iff all three |g_i/g_i_PDG - 1| < 0.01.
    8:   FAIL iff any |g_i/g_i_PDG - 1| > 0.10.
    9:   INFO otherwise.
   10: 
   11: Method:
   12:   1. Chamseddine-Connes a_4 boundary condition at Lambda_GUT = M_KK:
   13:        g_1^SU5(M_KK) = g_2(M_KK) = g_3(M_KK) = g_GUT
   14:      where g_GUT is structural, fixed by the spectral action a_4 normalization.
   15:   2. For this test, g_GUT is determined by the internal-consistency structural
   16:      condition: at the boundary scale, the three couplings must coincide. We
   17:      extract g_GUT from alpha_2^-1(M_KK) = alpha_3^-1(M_KK) (the two asymptotically
   18:      free couplings that naturally meet), then test whether g_1 agrees.
   19:      This is a ONE-parameter structural BC (g_GUT) predicting THREE couplings.
   20:   3. 1-loop SM RGE: d(1/alpha_i)/d(ln mu) = -b_i/(2*pi)
   21:      with (b_1, b_2, b_3) = (41/10, -19/6, -7) in SM hypercharge normalization for b_1.
   22:   4. g_1 in SU(5) GUT normalization: g_1^SU5 = sqrt(5/3) * g_1^SM.
   23:      Correspondingly, b_1^SU5 = (3/5) * b_1^SM = (3/5)(41/10) = 123/50.
   24:   5. Run each alpha_i from M_KK down to M_Z, then convert back to g_i^SM for
   25:      comparison to PDG.

   27: Pre-registered substitution chain:
   28:   alpha_i^-1(M_Z) = alpha_i^-1(M_KK) + (b_i / (2*pi)) * ln(M_KK/M_Z)  (i=2,3 directly)
   29:   alpha_1_SU5^-1(M_Z) = alpha_1_SU5^-1(M_KK) + (b_1_SU5 / (2*pi)) * ln(M_KK/M_Z)
   30:   g_1^SM = sqrt(3/5) * g_1_SU5
